newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE sugar stays tightly mixed, volume good..
newsitem.headline: LIFFE sugar stays tightly mixed, volume good..

text.p: LIFFE sugar was tightly mixed in good volume, traders said.
By 1520 GMT front month August was 40 cents lower at $318.70. August volume was 2,095 lots of a total of 4,622.
"It's not doing much," one trader said. "It's absorbed any hedging from the EU tender."
The volume included a lot of switches and AA trades, he said.

A total of 69,000 tonnes of current series white sugar received export rebates of a maximum 41.846 European Currency Units (Ecus) per 100 kilos at Wednesday's European Union (EU) tender, the U.K. Intervention Board said.
